game_title: Stack Of Plates – Pillar Maze Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round, ghost knights strike the obelisk, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the obelisk from ghost knights in Pillar Maze: keep the stack_balance meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: stack_balance drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while stack_balance > 0.
